code.title: Your sign-in code
code.description: Enter this code in the window where you asked to sign in.
code.missing: This link has no code. Ask for a new one from the sign-in screen.
code.notYou: Didn't ask for anything? Ignore this message: without this code, nobody can get in.

errors.noEmail: This account has no email address.
errors.couldNotSendLink: Could not send the sign-in link.

passkeyPrompt.title: Make your next sign-in simpler?
passkeyPrompt.description: Do you want to make your next sign-in simpler with a passkey? You will sign in with your fingerprint, face or device code, without waiting for an email.

passkeyAdd.title: Add a passkey
passkeyAdd.description: You will sign in to Savoire with your fingerprint, face or this device's code, without waiting for an email.
passkeyAdd.descriptionMore: You already have a passkey. Add one for this device, or for another passkey manager.
passkeyAdd.confirmFirst: First confirm it's you: we will send you a link by email.
passkeyAdd.codeSent: The link in the email shows a code: enter it here.
passkeyAdd.done: Passkey added. You can close this tab and go back to Savoire.

errors.unknownAccount: Account not found. Open this page again from Savoire (Settings, Account).
errors.organization: Your organization manages your sign-ins: ask its administrator.
errors.notAllowed: Passkeys are not allowed for this account.
errors.wrongCode: This code does not work. Check it, or ask for a new link.

loginname.title: Sign in
loginname.description: Enter your email address. You will get a link, or be asked for your passkey.

errors.userNotFound: No account with this address. Choose "Create an account".

verify.title: Check your email
verify.emailDescription: We sent you a link. It shows a code: enter it here.

verify.title: Verify your address
verify.description: We sent you a link. It shows a code: enter it here.
verify.codeSent: A link was just sent to your address.

register.title: Create an account
register.description: No password: you will sign in with a link sent by email, or with a passkey.
